prompt: Hi, AI! Please provide some Python code to load the CLIP ViT-B/32 model with perceptor, preprocess.
response:
To load the CLIP ViT-B/32 model, you can use the following Python code snippet. This example demonstrates how to load the model and preprocess an image for input:

```python
import torch
import clip
from PIL import Image

# Load the CLIP model
model_name = "ViT-B/32"
device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
model, preprocess = clip.load(model_name, device=device)

# Preprocess an image
image = Image.open("path_to_your_image.jpg")
image_input = preprocess(image).unsqueeze(0).to(device)

# Encode the image
with torch.no_grad():
    image_features = model.encode_image(image_input)
```

This code will load the CLIP model and preprocess an image for input. You can then use the model to encode the image and obtain its features.
